name: g75_pure_power_special
purpose: Pure Power on a SPECIAL move (step G75, the M03 survivor): Medicham (M) with Pure Power, holding Life Orb, uses Psychic (a Special move) on turn 1 and turn 2. Pure Power is a physical-only x2 (data/abilities.ts:3608-3617, the ModifyAtk event of a physical move), so the Psychic damage is not doubled; a mutant that drops the physical gate doubles it.
